verses.text: The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you.
Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid.
After the fire came a gentle whisper.
Trust in the Lord with all thine heart.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee.
They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength.
Fear not, for I am with thee; be not dismayed.
When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee.
For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord.
The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble.
Take no thought for the morrow; for the morrow shall take thought for itself.
Come unto me, all ye that labour, and I will give you rest.
He said to the sea, Peace, be still.
Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you.
All things work together for good to them that love God.
Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing.
We are pressed on every side, but not crushed.
My grace is sufficient for thee.
Do not be anxious about anything.
I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love.
I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
